units.source_text: 柏木揪住我的肩膀，气喘吁吁。

en.t: Kashiwagi grabbed my shoulder, panting for breath.

units.source_text: 这大概是在放学后的五点半光景，

en.t: This was probably around half past five after school,

units.source_text: 为了避免碰见柏木，我从图书馆出来后，

en.t: and in order to avoid running into Kashiwagi, after leaving the library,

units.source_text: 绕到校舍后面，从西边简易的教室和高高的石墙之间的通路走过来。

en.t: I had gone around behind the school building and come along the passage between the simple classrooms on the west side and the high stone wall.

units.source_text: 那里是一片荒地，野菊丛生，

en.t: There was a stretch of wasteland there, overgrown with wild chrysanthemums,

units.source_text: 地上扔下了许多纸屑和空罐，

en.t: with many scraps of paper and empty cans thrown on the ground,

units.source_text: 悄悄地溜进来的孩子们在投棒球。

en.t: and children who had slipped in quietly were playing catch with a baseball.

units.source_text: 他们的喧嚣声越过玻璃门窗，

en.t: Their noisy voices carried past the glass doors and windows,

units.source_text: 使放学后落满灰尘的成排书桌的教室显得格外空荡无人。

en.t: making the classroom, with its rows of desks covered in dust after school, seem especially empty and deserted.
